action.objective: Complete broad search over all legal moves to find the strongest continuation after Nxf7+; identify tactical wins and safest king/development options.
action.rationale: Position is sharp: White queen on g4 and knight on f7 attack Black's king and rook on h8. Broad search is required before selecting a candidate. Key tactical ideas include Nxh8 winning the rook, Qxg7 threats, and possible Black bishop on c6 counterplay (Bxh1 or Bxf2+ ideas). Need full root coverage at depth 4 to compare forcing captures against quiet consolidating moves and check king safety.
